title: Tzatziki
desc: Greek yoghurt, cucumber, garlic, lemon and dill or mint.

ingredients.name: Lebanese cucumber, grated and squeezed dry
fresh dill or mint, chopped
ingredients.food: fresh herbs (dill, mint, parsley or chives)

steps.title: Squeeze the cucumber
steps.text: Grate the cucumber and squeeze it hard in your hands or a clean tea towel. This stops the tzatziki going watery.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Stir everything into the yoghurt with a pinch of salt. Best after 10 minutes in the fridge. Keeps 3 days.

notes: Made with high-protein Greek yoghurt (about 60 kcal and 10 g protein per 100 g). Full-fat Greek yoghurt roughly doubles the calories and halves the protein.
